## Immutable basis

## Protected material / consumers
Excluded in test_mcp_on_box_infra.py as concise/load-bearing (word counts): C:test_mcp_entrypoint_is_a_real_file_installed_onto_path:before:build-context-assert(12), C:<module>:before:_MCP_REGION_VARS:heading(4), C:<module>:before:_MCP_REGION_VARS:region-fact(18), D:_server_443_block(8), C:test_nginx_serves_the_documented_mcp_slash_url_without_redirecting:before:proxy-pass-assert(28), C:<module>:before:_ADVERTISED_METADATA_PATH:url(13), C:test_nginx_routes_the_advertised_resource_metadata_url_to_the_mcp_app:before:proxy-pass-assert(21), C:test_nginx_asserts_hsts_on_every_tls_response:before:max-age-assert(11). Preserve all other prose, inline comments, runtime strings, regexes, prompts, assertions, data, and executable AST. The 10 directive lines retain exact text and inline/next-code attachment; shebang count is 0. No selected docstring has a runtime documentation consumer. Pytest collects all 18 modules; comment hygiene scans them.

## Independent receipt
A non-author posts exactly 70 leaf-linked TSV rows:
`stable_id<TAB>full_before_SHA:path#ID<TAB>full_final_SHA:path#ID<TAB>contract_or_consumer<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>semantic_preservation<TAB>bloat_removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
Each has `after_words < before_words` and PASS in all 3 verdict columns. Missing/duplicate/extra, author-reviewed, short-SHA, or non-PASS rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 70 allowlisted blocks are shorter and retain each path's contracts.
- [ ] Parent/final parse with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; remove only allowed leading docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require exact attribute-free AST dumps.
- [ ] Immutable target text equals the leaf parent; protected prose/directives/shebangs match; zero-context hunks stay inside resolved immutable spans/adjacent blanks.
- [ ] `HEAD^..HEAD` equals all 18 impacts; focused pytest, scoped Ruff check/format, hygiene, diff check, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify` pass.
- [ ] Exactly 70 fully cited independent PASS rows exist.

## Verification
Run all 7 persisted DD commands: immutable-prose-only, exact-leaf-paths, focused-tests, scoped-ruff, comment-hygiene, diff-integrity, repository-gates.
